sources.title: S1-mini vs Parakeet: Superwhisper Is Not ASR (2026) - explainx.ai
sources.snippet: S1-mini is not a speech-to-text model. It is a 0.6B Qwen fine-tune that sits after ASR and rewrites the messy transcript into something you would actually paste into Slack. Superwhisper's August 19, 2026 announcement called it a language model that "processes transcripts entirely on your device." That wording is exact.

sources.title: Meet S1-mini: Superwhisper's 462 MB Open-Weights Text Normalizer That ...
sources.snippet: S1-mini is a 0.6B open-weights text normalizer for ASR output, not a transcriber or chat model. The Q4_K_M GGUF is 462 MB and runs on a laptop CPU, so on-device deployment is realistic.
